chunks: And when your Lord called Moses, [saying]: 'Go to the wicked people,'

key_terms.الظَّالِمِينَ: The wicked / Those who do injustice

ai.seo_question: Who did God call Moses to go to in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from divine selection to active mission, emphasizing Moses' (AS) role as a bearer of truth to the tyrannical court of Pharaoh. The term 'zalimin' underscores the systemic injustice of the ruling elite, framing the prophetic mission as a corrective force against political and spiritual oppression. This narrative serves as a paradigm for the Imams' struggle against contemporary rulers, illustrating the duty to convey divine guidance despite entrenched authority.
